name: Ignite Master
author: team@ignite.network
description: Zentraler Rust-Master für das Ignite Minecraft-Netzwerk. Empfängt Backups von Servern, steuert Pterodactyl, managed nahtlose Server-Wechsel inkl. Proxy.

installation.script:
# Ignite Master - Pterodactyl Installer
set -euo pipefail

GITHUB_REPO="{{env.GITHUB_REPO}}"
RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest"
ARCH="$(uname -m)"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# 1) Download prebuilt binary (x86_64)
if [ "${ARCH}" = "x86_64" ]; then
    echo "[+] Architecture: ${ARCH} - trying release download..."
    RELEASE_JSON=$(curl -sfL "${RELEASE_URL}" || echo "")
    if [ -n "${RELEASE_JSON}" ]; then
        ASSET_URL=$(echo "${RELEASE_JSON}" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for a in d.get('assets',[]):
    if 'x86_64' in a['name'] or 'x86_64' in a['browser_download_url']:
        print(a['browser_download_url'])
        break
" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        if [ -n "${ASSET_URL}" ]; then
            echo "[+] Downloading: ${ASSET_URL}"
            curl -sfL "${ASSET_URL}" -o release.tar.gz
            tar xzf release.tar.gz
            rm release.tar.gz
            chmod +x ignite-master
            echo "[+] Binary installed."
            exit 0
        fi
    fi
    echo "[!] No release found, building from source..."
fi

# 2) Build from source (fallback)
echo "[+] Building from source (arch: ${ARCH})..."
if ! command -v cargo &>/dev/null; then
    echo "[+] Installing Rust via rustup..."
    curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y
    . "$HOME/.cargo/env"
fi
echo "[+] Cloning ${GITHUB_REPO}..."
rm -rf ignite-src
git clone --depth 1 "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}.git" ignite-src
cd ignite-src/master
echo "[+] Running cargo build --release..."
cargo build --release
cp target/release/ignite-master /mnt/server/
cp /mnt/server/ignite-src/ignite-config.example.toml /mnt/server/ 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x /mnt/server/ignite-master
echo "[+] Build complete."

variables.name: Target A Address
variables.description: IP:Port von Server A (aus Master-Sicht, z.B. 172.18.0.2:25577)
